popCulture.title: Ion
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Delphi tragedy makes Creusa the Erechtheid princess who bore Ion to Apollo in the cave, then married Xuthus — the mother who nearly kills her unrecognized son before recognition restores the Athenian line.

popCulture.title: Creusa, Queen of Athens
popCulture.creator: William Whitehead
popCulture.description: Whitehead's Drury Lane tragedy rewrites Euripides' Creusa for the Georgian stage — the Athenian queen still at the centre of the Ion recognition plot.

popCulture.title: Creusa of Athens
popCulture.description: Daughter of Erechtheus, mother of Ion by Apollo (and of Achaeus by Xuthus in some genealogies) — not Creusa of Troy, nor Glauce/Creusa of Corinth.
